learning_outcomes.text: After completing the course, students will be able to create a simple server-side web application with personalized access to individual parts of the application. The data will be stored in a database.

syllabus_topics: Variables, constants, strings, operators, conditions, loops
working with date and time, arrays, functions to work with arrays and strings
Form processing, input processing and treatment
Introduction to working with a database
Working with multiple tables at the same time
assessment_rules: To pass the course, at least 70% of the semester points are needed for the practical exam. The final grade is determined by a 20/80 scale for preliminary (practical assignments, project) and final (practical exam) assessment respectively. The indicative evaluation scale is A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%.
